messages.author: 5ecbf74042d3398c
messages.subject: Cannot install aroma.affymetrix on Ubuntu
parts:
Hello,

I tried to install aroma.affymetrix many times,
After I ran these two lines of code:

source("http://www.braju.com/R/hbLite.R")
hbInstall("aroma.affymetrix")

every time I ended up installing Bioconductor all over again, and
finally when it came to install aroma.affymetrix the result was this:

Searching for locally installed packages...done
Updating packages: aroma.affymetrix from http://www.braju.com/R/repos
01/01. aroma.affymetrix: not available.
Searching for locally installed packages...done
Updating packages: sfit from http://www.braju.com/R/repos
01/01. sfit: v0.1.5, i.e. up to date.

with these warnigns:

Warning messages:
1: no package 'preprocessCore' was found in: packageDescription(pkg)
2: Redefining 'biocinstall' in: safeSource()
3: Redefining 'biocinstallPkgGroups' in: safeSource()
4: Redefining 'biocinstallRepos' in: safeSource()
5: package 'preprocessCore' is not available in: install.packages(pkgs
= pkgs, repos = repos, dependencies = dependencies, ...
6: no package 'preprocessCore' was found in: packageDescription(pkg)
7: Redefining 'biocinstall' in: safeSource()
8: Redefining 'biocinstallPkgGroups' in: safeSource()
9: Redefining 'biocinstallRepos' in: safeSource()
10: package 'preprocessCore' is not available in:
install.packages(pkgs = pkgs, repos = repos, dependencies =
dependencies, ...
11: Redefining 'biocinstall' in: safeSource()
12: Redefining 'biocinstallPkgGroups' in: safeSource()
13: Redefining 'biocinstallRepos' in: safeSource()
14: Redefining 'biocinstall' in: safeSource()
15: Redefining 'biocinstallPkgGroups' in: safeSource()
16: Redefining 'biocinstallRepos' in: safeSource()

and when I tested the installation by >library(aroma.affymetrix), it
said : no package name aroma.affymetrix.

Please help me get through this.
Thank you.

Yotsawat Pomyen

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Cannot install aroma.affymetrix on Ubuntu
parts:
Hi,

could you please provide us with your sessionInfo() and let us know if
you can install CRAN and Bioconductor packages otherwise. It might be
a more general problem with your R setup that is independent to
aroma.affymetrix. So, please try to install some CRAN and
Bioconductor packages and verify that you have no problems with those.
If you have a problem installing those as well, please use the r-help
mailing list for further help.

/Henrik

messages.author: 5ecbf74042d3398c
messages.subject: Re: Cannot install aroma.affymetrix on Ubuntu
parts:
Hi,

I already know what's the problem.
It's the version of R, pre-installed was 2.5.1 but the package
requires the newest (2.6.2).

So, I can install it now. Thanks for your help.
